subject: delta(client): WF record a host stop's or a re-hold's suspension at a seller request, in the continuation or at the public gate whether or not work is queued, and keep a purchase's first suspension
note: A host stop or a re-hold seen when a seller request that stores its bytes starts, before its send or at the wire signer, by verifyDeal's continuation, or a host stop refusing a public service method for the purchase its request authenticates for, now records state.protocol.sellerSuspension whether or not work is queued; on the two read routes only queued work records one. A purchase keeps its first suspension and its id, a later stop or re-hold writes nothing, and only resume(id) clears it. createSellerRequestRecords' suspendQueued(cause) becomes suspend(cause), with no queued-work condition. Restated tests: the start-without-queued-work and gate cases now expect the suspension, and the re-hold barrier readback expects only the re-hold's suspension. New test file test/stop-seam.test.mjs covers the durable record, a killed wallet-lane holder, the lstat stop file check at each boundary, the kept first suspension, a failed suspension write, and two resumes racing.
